events.label: Fox News poll of Texas voters

slots.name: Senate poll lead
slots.sentence: Paxton trailed Talarico by 2 points in a September Fox News poll.

slots.name: personal rating
slots.sentence: The poll found an even wider gap in likely voters’ favorability ratings of the two candidates, with Talarico earning an 8-point net positive rating, while Paxton came in at 18 points underwater.

slots.name: Abbott crossover support
slots.sentence: The poll found 10 percent of Talarico supporters are backing Abbott for reelection.

slots.name: Republican unfavorability of Paxton
slots.sentence: Republicans are six times more likely to view Paxton unfavorably (32%) than Democrats do Talarico (5%).

slots.name: Democratic Senate preference
slots.sentence: Overall, Texas likely voters split on control of the Senate: 49% prefer a Democratic Senate while 50% favor a Republican upper chamber.

slots.name: registered voter lead
slots.sentence: Among the larger sample of registered voters, Talarico’s advantage widens to 7 points (just outside the margin of error). That’s up from a 3-point edge in July.

slots.name: Cornyn voters for Talarico
slots.sentence: The crossover echoes lingering divisions from the competitive GOP primary and runoff: 20% of likely voters who backed Republican incumbent Sen. John Cornyn in the March primary back Talarico.

slots.name: DSA Democrat Talarico support
slots.sentence: Fully 100% of DSA Democrats and 98% of non-DSA Democrats back Talarico, and slightly more of his backers are certain of their support (89%) than Paxton backers (85%).

events.label: Fox News October 1 2026 Texas Senate poll

slots.name: vote share
slots.sentence: A new Fox News poll shows the Texas U.S. Senate race tightening weeks before Election Day, with Democrat James Talarico holding a narrow two-point lead over Republican Ken Paxton, 51% to 49%.

slots.name: sample size
slots.sentence: The poll, released Oct. 1, surveyed 1,203 likely Texas voters between Sept. 24 and Sept. 28.

slots.name: favorability results
slots.sentence: Fifty-two percent of respondents view Talarico favorably compared with 44% unfavorably, while Paxton sits at 40% favorable and 58% unfavorable.

slots.name: Senate race lead
slots.sentence: Texas state Rep. James Talarico (D) is leading state Attorney General Ken Paxton (R) by just 2 points among likely voters, according to a new Fox News poll.

slots.name: Senate poll margin
slots.sentence: The Democrat’s lead is within the poll’s 3-point margin of error and shows a tight race in the Lone Star State.

slots.name: Favorability net rating
slots.sentence: There’s an even wider gap in likely voters’ favorability ratings of the two candidates, with Talarico earning an 8-point net positive rating while Paxton comes in at 18 points underwater.

slots.name: Registered voter lead
slots.sentence: While the race is narrow among likely voters, Talarico holds a wider 7-point lead — outside the margin of error — among the larger pool of registered voters.

slots.name: Cost importance
slots.sentence: Seventy percent of likely voters reported that the cost of living will be important to their Senate vote, with Talarico leading Paxton by 32 points among those who said they are falling behind economically.

slots.name: Economic support gap
slots.sentence: Respondents who said they are getting ahead economically support Paxton by a 48-point advantage, and those who said they are holding steady economically backed Paxton by 3 points.

slots.name: Candidate perception
slots.sentence: A majority of likely voters said Talarico was too liberal, 53 percent, and that Paxton was too close to Trump, 51 percent.

slots.name: unfavorable view ratio
slots.sentence: The poll found Republicans are more than six times more likely to hold an unfavorable view of Paxton than Democrats do of Talarico.

values.name: registered voter lead
